I use remote sensing, field data, and spatial models to understand how western ecosystems respond to disturbance and management. These highlights include collaborative work from my roles at CSU NREL and NASA DEVELOP, alongside ongoing research; related and publically available technical reports are linked below.

::: project-feature
## Highlighted project

### Post-fire snowpack dynamics in the Colorado Front Range

How do burn severity and snow zone shape snow depth across the accumulation and melt seasons? My team and I combine airborne lidar, field observations, and terrain data to investigate this across two Front Range watershed using airborne Lidar and satellite imagery.

*Manuscript in preparation.*
:::
